issues: A full light page screenshot filled the frame, so the five cards were off-white on light grey: subject and background nearly the same tone, with no light or depth
The counter was squeezed into the top-right corner (104px digits plus 19–22px labels) and never won the hierarchy against the stack
The press moved the whole stack 6px down on one frame, barely visible on screen, so the weight didn't read
Cards came in on an even 12f beat and the end overshoot pushed each one into the card above, reading as overlap rather than impact
The highlight grew for 7f then faded over 5f, so the final frame didn't show which projects matched
changes: Ember look (warm black + orange): the screenshot paper cards (textures untouched, only a warm grade) stand as their own column on the dark stage, glowing as the subject; the rust project names in the screenshots match the accent

The left side is purpose-built counter typography: PAPER RADAR kicker, a 300px rolling "5" with "/ 31", a progress hairline and a 42px line rising word by word; the roll window fades top and bottom and the digit blooms orange once on the final settle

The beat tightens 14→12→10→9f, and the flight curve keeps residual speed so each card really hits the stack; the press is now an impact wave: the new card rebounds 8px, the one above lifts 14px, each further card 1.5f later and ×0.7, one damped rebound
The follow-through order is kept: card stops, stack rebounds, the project-name highlighter grows 3f later and stays to the end, then the counter rolls one step (8f)

One continuous camera curve pulls from a 1.0× close-up of the first card to a 0.74× full stack and holds after 90f; one glaze sweeps the stack after the last card (once, clipped to each card); 120f total with a clean ~16f poster at the end
